evidence_note: RETROSPECTIVE, not pre-registered: built after the election with the result and market resolutions known. Settings were chosen on the 2022 and 2019 count nights replayed from the same AEC archive in feed order; no 2025 count went into them.
settle_gated_note: per race: gate = first minute with >= 1% of the expected polling-place votes counted; model = max(model settle, gate); lead = market settle - gated model settle, minutes (settle = staying >= 0.9 on the outcome to the last frame, 04:00 AEST); market = Polymarket where the race has one, else Kalshi

reasons.capacity: dollars of real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price in the 30 min after each frozen-rule signal (0 s latency); the trades come from Polymarket's public data API
reasons.profit: the frozen night rule run unchanged on this replay (analysis/edge_audit.py); decided-before-count markets were already priced near 0 or 1, so the rule finds few trades there
reasons.arbitrage: no thin-spread Polymarket-Kalshi pairs through the count were checked
reasons.calibration: minutes from 1% to 95% of the expected polling-place votes counted; Labor's final seat count against the model's 90% range (the same range applies to every seat market)

accuracy.pwin_window: contested = the markets the platform had not settled (>= 0.9 on the outcome to the end) before the first two-candidate count; minutes from then to the last frame (04:00 AEST)
accuracy.outcome: AEC final results (media feed, last archived message), which match every Polymarket and Kalshi resolution

profit.rule: frozen night rule: favoured side only, edge >= 5c after costs, >= 1% of the market counted, first signal per market, held to resolution
profit.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; return at the signal's all-in cost (price + 1c half-spread + taker fee)

brier_by_counted.window: minutes from the first two-candidate count to the last frame (2025-05-03T08:33:00Z to 2025-05-03T16:37:00Z)

brier.window: minutes from the first two-candidate count to the last frame (2025-05-03T08:33:00Z to 2025-05-03T16:37:00Z)

sensitivity_v2.note: v2 adds floors under the state and national swing errors and compares a third candidate with the leading major party; written after v1 had been scored on the 2025 count and its misses inspected

market_classification.definition: eventual outcome >= 0.90 at the first minute at/after official poll close and never below 0.80 afterwards

mix.label: tau mixture over earlier nights (chosen after the result was known)
mix.note: Instead of one setting for how wrong the early count can be, the model is run twice, once with the national swing error that the 2019 night needed and once with the one the 2022 night needed (equal weights, the seat draws pooled); the 2025 count and result chose nothing, but the idea was adopted after the result was known.

summary.coverage90_headline_definition: Labor seat count inside the 90% band over frames with 1% < counted <= 95% (the definition of stats.calibration.most-alp)

seats_coverage90_1_95.definition: Labor's final seat count against the pooled draws' mean +- 1.645 sd (sd floored at 0.8), as the v1 headline calibration is defined

v2.label: v2: added after the 2025 count was scored

summary.coverage90_headline_definition: Labor seat count inside the 90% band over frames with 1% < counted <= 95% (the definition of stats.calibration.most-alp)

invest10k.execution: model limit: after the 1% gate, 10% of every real taker trade (Israel: resting ask in the recorded book) on the favoured side whose all-in price leaves the model >= 5c, using the model P known >= 60 s earlier; no per-market cap
invest10k.note: Single event: every bet depends on the same election-night count, so the markets move together and this is one outcome, not many independent bets. 61% of the eligible volume was in one market (will-the-next-government-of-australia-be-a-labor-majority). Eligible volume is an upper bound: other traders took those trades.

signal_price.execution: real taker trades on our side at or better than the signal price, from 60 s to 30 min after the signal; cost = signal price + half-spread + taker fee (retrospective replay, v1)
